description: Source code for the Port driver in an AUTOSAR-based embedded system, specifically for MPC55xx architecture. Implements port initialization, pin direction setting, port refresh, and pin mode configuration.

methods.name: Port_Init
methods.description: Initializes port pins based on provided configuration, setting register values accordingly.

methods.name: Port_SetPinDirection
methods.description: Sets the direction (input/output) of a specific port pin.

methods.name: Port_RefreshPortDirection
methods.description: Refreshes the port pin directions based on current configuration.

methods.name: Port_GetVersionInfo
methods.description: Retrieves version information of the Port module.

methods.name: Port_SetPinMode
methods.description: Sets the mode of a specific port pin.
